content.text: Hãy tìm hiểu chức năng Tuyển dụng của website này, gồm tuyen-dung.html và tất cả các file liên quan đi cùng với chức năng này. Tôi muốn nâng cấp Tính năng Nhập Địa điểm để thông minh và đầy đủ hơn, nó phải hiện ra list các thành phố, chọn thành phố thì sẽ ra quận, khu vực tương ứng thuộc thành phố đó. Ví dụ trong dang-tin-viec-lam.html cần phải chọn được thành phố và quận huyện tương ứng. Hay ngoài trang tuyen-dung.html, chỗ filter, không chỉ cho chọn thành phố mà còn phải có thêm dropdownlist để chọn quận huyện tương ứng. Tóm lại là tất cả những gì liên quan đến địa điểm, khu vực thì cần phải đáp ứng được thông tin thành phố và quận huyện đi kèm, bao gồm nhập vào và xuất ra. Lưu ý, ngữ cảnh website này đang là prototype frontend, tôi muốn thiết kế thật chuẩn giao diệ tính năng, để sau đó code thêm backend theo hướng dùng HTML tĩnh kết hợp với Cloudflare Functions / Workers, Supabase . Hãy trình bày lại chứng tỏ bạn hiểu ý tôi

*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: tools/reclassify_phase9_thu_vien_huong_dan_phan_mem_cong_cu.py
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Phase 9: rà và sửa nhóm Hướng dẫn > Phần mềm - Công cụ."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import importlib.util
+import json
+import re
+from datetime import datetime
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Dict, List, Tuple
+
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
+OUT_JSON = ROOT / "docs" / "thu-vien-phase9-huong-dan-phan-mem-cong-cu.json"
+OUT_MD = ROOT / "docs" / "thu-vien-phase9-huong-dan-phan-mem-cong-cu.md"
+
+META_RE = re.compile(
+    r'(<script id="article-meta" type="application/json">)(.*?)(</script>)',
+    re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL,
+)
+
+LIBRARY_KIND_LABELS = {
+    "huong-dan": "Hướng dẫn",
+    "bieu-mau": "Biểu mẫu",
+    "cong-cu": "Công cụ",
+    "van-ban": "Văn bản",
+}
+
+
+DECISIONS: Dict[str, Dict[str, str]] = {
+    # Bài quy định lao động không phải hướng dẫn phần mềm
+    "thu-vien/quy-dinh-ve-bao-cao-tinh-hinh-su-dung-lao-dong.html": {
+        "kind": "huong-dan",
+        "lv1": "lao-dong-bao-hiem",
+        "lv2": "lao-dong-tien-luong",
+        "lv3": "ho-so-thu-tuc-lao-dong",
+        "reason": "bao-cao-lao-dong-thu-tuc",
+    },
+    # Bài tổng hợp hạn/mức phạt thuế không gắn thao tác phần mềm cụ thể
+    "thu-vien/thoi-han-nop-cac-loai-bao-cao-thue-nam-moi-nhat.html": {
+        "kind": "huong-dan",
+        "lv1": "thue",
+        "lv2": "gtgt-hoa-don",
+        "lv3": "bao-cao-bang-ke",
+        "reason": "lich-nop-bao-cao-thue-tong-hop",
+    },
+    "thu-vien/muc-phat-cham-nop-ho-so-khai-thue-gtgt-tncn-tndn.html": {
+        "kind": "huong-dan",
+        "lv1": "thue",
+        "lv2": "gtgt-hoa-don",
+        "lv3": "ke-khai-gtgt",
+        "reason": "muc-phat-khai-thue-da-sac-thue",
+    },
+    "thu-vien/muc-phat-cham-nop-tien-mon-bai.html": {
+        "kind": "huong-dan",
+        "lv1": "thue",
+        "lv2": "le-phi-mon-bai",
+        "lv3": "mon-bai-ke-khai-to-khai",
+        "reason": "muc-phat-mon-bai",
+    },
+}
+
+
+def load_importer_module():
+    module_path = ROOT / "tools" / "import_stage1_20.py"
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("importer_phase9_huongdan_phanmem", module_path)
+    if spec is None or spec.loader is None:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"Không import được module: {module_path}")
+    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    spec.loader.exec_module(module)  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+    return module
+
+
+def build_label_maps(articles: List[Dict]) -> Tuple[Dict[str, str], Dict[str, str], Dict[str, str]]:
+    lv1: Dict[str, str] = {}
+    lv2: Dict[str, str] = {}
+    lv3: Dict[str, str] = {}
+    for a in articles:
+        if a.get("topicLv1Key"):
+            lv1.setdefault(a["topicLv1Key"], a.get("topicLv1Label") or a["topicLv1Key"])
+        if a.get("topicLv2Key"):
+            lv2.setdefault(a["topicLv2Key"], a.get("topicLv2Label") or a["topicLv2Key"])
+        if a.get("topicLv3Key"):
+            lv3.setdefault(a["topicLv3Key"], a.get("topicLv3Label") or a["topicLv3Key"])
+    return lv1, lv2, lv3
+
+
+def update_meta(path: Path, article: Dict) -> Tuple[bool, str]:
+    if not path.exists():
+        return False, "missing-file"
+    html = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")
+    m = META_RE.search(html)
+    if not m:
+        return False, "missing-article-meta"
+    try:
+        meta = json.loads(m.group(2))
+    except json.JSONDecodeError:
+        return False, "invalid-article-meta-json"
+
+    for key in (
+        "section",
+        "sectionLabel",
+        "sectionHref",
+        "libraryKindKey",
+        "libraryKindLabel",
+        "cardBadgeLabel",
+        "topicLv1Key",
+        "topicLv1Label",
+        "topicLv2Key",
+        "topicLv2Label",
+        "topicLv3Key",
+        "topicLv3Label",
+        "cardTopicLabel",
+    ):
+        meta[key] = article.get(key) or ""
+    meta["sectionKey"] = article.get("section") or ""
+    meta["topicLabel"] = article.get("topicLv2Label") or article.get("topicLv1Label") or ""
+
+    replaced = html[: m.start(2)] + json.dumps(meta, ensure_ascii=False) + html[m.end(2) :]
+    path.write_text(replaced, encoding="utf-8")
+    return True, "updated"
+
+
+def rebuild(importer, data_articles: List[Dict]) -> Dict[str, int]:
+    records_by_section: Dict[str, List[Dict]] = {"thu-vien": [], "ban-tin": []}
+    for idx, item in enumerate(data_articles):
+        rec = {
+            "file": Path(item["href"]).name.replace(".html", ".htm"),
+            "target_root": item["href"],
+            "section": item["section"],
+            "title": item["title"],
+            "excerpt": item.get("excerpt") or "",
+            "content_html": "",
+            "topic_lv1_key": item.get("topicLv1Key") or "",
+            "topic_lv1_label": item.get("topicLv1Label") or "",
+            "topic_lv2_key": item.get("topicLv2Key") or "",
+            "topic_lv2_label": item.get("topicLv2Label") or "",
+            "topic_lv3_key": item.get("topicLv3Key") or "",
+            "topic_lv3_label": item.get("topicLv3Label") or "",
+            "tags": item.get("tags") or [],
+            "display_badge": item.get("cardBadgeLabel") or "",
+            "display_topic": item.get("cardTopicLabel") or "",
+            "library_kind_key": item.get("libraryKindKey") or "",
+            "library_kind_label": item.get("libraryKindLabel") or "",
+            "tool_lv3_key": item.get("toolLv3Key") or "",
+            "tool_lv3_label": item.get("toolLv3Label") or "",
+            "publish_date": item.get("publishDate") or "",
+            "modified_date": item.get("modifiedDate"),
+            "author_name": item.get("authorName") or "Kế Toán Diệu Tâm",
+            "author_type": item.get("authorType") or "Organization",
+            "hub_image": item.get("image") or importer.FEATURE_IMAGE_PATH,
+            "catalog_index": idx,
+        }
+        records_by_section[item["section"]].append(rec)
+
+    for sec in ("thu-vien", "ban-tin"):
+        records_by_section[sec].sort(key=lambda r: importer.fold(r["title"]))
+        for i, r in enumerate(records_by_section[sec]):
+            r["catalog_index"] = i
+
+    page_maps = {}
+    for sec in ("thu-vien", "ban-tin"):
+        total_pages = max(1, (len(records_by_section[sec]) + importer.PAGE_SIZE - 1) // importer.PAGE_SIZE)
+        page_maps[sec] = importer.build_page_map(sec, total_pages)
+
+    importer.rebuild_hub_pages(records_by_section, page_maps)
+    idx_data = importer.build_content_index(records_by_section)
+    importer.write_content_index(idx_data)
+    importer.write_data_artifacts(records_by_section, idx_data, page_maps)
+    importer.write_taxonomy_data(records_by_section)
+    importer.write_sitemap(idx_data, page_maps)
+    return {
+        "thu_vien_count": len(records_by_section["thu-vien"]),
+        "ban_tin_count": len(records_by_section["ban-tin"]),
+        "thu_vien_pages": len(page_maps["thu-vien"]),
+        "ban_tin_pages": len(page_maps["ban-tin"]),
+    }
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    importer = load_importer_module()
+    data_articles_path = importer.DATA_DIR / "articles.json"
+    data_articles: List[Dict] = importer.read_json(data_articles_path)
+    article_map = {a["href"]: a for a in data_articles}
+    lv1_labels, lv2_labels, lv3_labels = build_label_maps(data_articles)
+
+    applied = []
+    skipped = []
+    for href, decision in DECISIONS.items():
+        article = article_map.get(href)
+        if not article:
+            skipped.append({"href": href, "reason": "missing-article"})
+            continue
+
+        kind = decision["kind"]
+        lv1 = decision["lv1"]
+        lv2 = decision["lv2"]
+        lv3 = decision["lv3"]
+        if kind not in LIBRARY_KIND_LABELS or lv1 not in lv1_labels or lv2 not in lv2_labels or lv3 not in lv3_labels:
+            skipped.append({"href": href, "reason": "missing-target-label", "decision": decision})
+            continue
+
+        before = {
+            "kind": article.get("libraryKindKey") or "",
+            "lv1": article.get("topicLv1Key") or "",
+            "lv2": article.get("topicLv2Key") or "",
+            "lv3": article.get("topicLv3Key") or "",
+        }
+
+        article["section"] = "thu-vien"
+        article["sectionLabel"] = "Thư viện"
+        article["sectionHref"] = "thu-vien.html"
+        article["libraryKindKey"] = kind
+        article["libraryKindLabel"] = LIBRARY_KIND_LABELS[kind]
+        article["cardBadgeLabel"] = LIBRARY_KIND_LABELS[kind]
+        article["topicLv1Key"] = lv1
+        article["topicLv1Label"] = lv1_labels[lv1]
+        article["topicLv2Key"] = lv2
+        article["topicLv2Label"] = lv2_labels[lv2]
+        article["topicLv3Key"] = lv3
+        article["topicLv3Label"] = lv3_labels[lv3]
+        article["cardTopicLabel"] = article["topicLv2Label"]
+        if isinstance(article.get("classificationReasons"), dict):
+            article["classificationReasons"]["phase9ThuVienPhanMemCongCu"] = decision["reason"]
+
+        ok, reason = update_meta(ROOT / href, article)
+        if not ok:
+            skipped.append({"href": href, "reason": reason})
+            continue
+
+        applied.append(
+            {
+                "href": href,
+                "title": article.get("title") or "",
+                "reason": decision["reason"],
+                "before": before,
+                "after": {
+                    "kind": article.get("libraryKindKey") or "",
+                    "lv1": article.get("topicLv1Key") or "",
+                    "lv2": article.get("topicLv2Key") or "",
+                    "lv3": article.get("topicLv3Key") or "",
+                },
+            }
+        )
+
+    importer.write_json(data_articles_path, data_articles)
+    counts = rebuild(importer, data_articles)
+
+    phase_bucket_after = [
+        a for a in data_articles
+        if a.get("section") == "thu-vien"
+        and a.get("libraryKindKey") == "huong-dan"
+        and a.get("topicLv1Key") == "phan-mem-cong-cu"
+    ]
+
+    payload = {
+        "generatedAt": datetime.now().isoformat(),
+        "phase": "phase9-huong-dan-phan-mem-cong-cu",
+        "appliedCount": len(applied),
+        "skippedCount": len(skipped),
+        "applied": applied,
+        "skipped": skipped,
+        "after": {
+            "remainingInBucket": len(phase_bucket_after),
+            "countsAfterRebuild": counts,
+        },
+        "deferredManualReview": [
+            {
+                "href": "thu-vien/danh-muc-he-thong-tai-khoan-ke-toan-theo-thong-tu-133.html",
+                "reason": "excel-tool-vs-ke-toan-reference-boundary",
+            }
+        ],
+    }
+    OUT_JSON.write_text(json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+
+    lines = [
+        "# Phase 9 - Rà soát Hướng dẫn / Phần mềm - Công cụ",
+        "",
+        f"- Thời gian chạy: `{datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')}`",
+        f"- Applied: **{len(applied)}**",
+        f"- Skipped: **{len(skipped)}**",
+        f"- Còn lại trong bucket sau phase 9: **{len(phase_bucket_after)}**",
+        f"- Rebuild: Thư viện {counts['thu_vien_count']} bài / {counts['thu_vien_pages']} trang; Bản tin {counts['ban_tin_count']} bài / {counts['ban_tin_pages']} trang",
+        "",
+        "## Các bài đã chỉnh",
+        "",
+        "| # | href | before | after | reason |",
+        "|---:|---|---|---|---|",
+    ]
+    for i, row in enumerate(applied, 1):
+        b = row["before"]
+        a = row["after"]
+        lines.append(
+            f"| {i} | `{row['href']}` | `{b['kind']} / {b['lv1']} / {b['lv2']} / {b['lv3']}` | `{a['kind']} / {a['lv1']} / {a['lv2']} / {a['lv3']}` | `{row['reason']}` |"
+        )
+    if skipped:
+        lines += ["", "## Skipped", ""]
+        for row in skipped:
+            lines.append(f"- `{row['href']}`: {row['reason']}")
+    lines += [
+        "",
+        "## Deferred manual review",
+        "",
+        "- `thu-vien/danh-muc-he-thong-tai-khoan-ke-toan-theo-thong-tu-133.html` (ranh giới công cụ tra cứu vs bài kiến thức kế toán tổng hợp)",
+    ]
+    OUT_MD.write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+
+    print(
+        json.dumps(
+            {
+                "applied": len(applied),
+                "skipped": len(skipped),
+                "remainingInBucket": len(phase_bucket_after),
+                "report": str(OUT_MD.relative_to(ROOT)),
+            },
+            ensure_ascii=False,
+            indent=2,
+        )
+    )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch

+def build_label_maps(articles: List[Dict]) -> Tuple[Dict[str, str], Dict[str, str], Dict[str, str]]:
+    lv1: Dict[str, str] = {}
+    lv2: Dict[str, str] = {}
+    lv3: Dict[str, str] = {}
+    for a in articles:
+        if a.get("topicLv1Key"):
+            lv1.setdefault(a["topicLv1Key"], a.get("topicLv1Label") or a["topicLv1Key"])
+        if a.get("topicLv2Key"):
+            lv2.setdefault(a["topicLv2Key"], a.get("topicLv2Label") or a["topicLv2Key"])
+        if a.get("topicLv3Key"):
+            lv3.setdefault(a["topicLv3Key"], a.get("topicLv3Label") or a["topicLv3Key"])
+    return lv1, lv2, lv3
+
+
+def update_meta(path: Path, article: Dict) -> Tuple[bool, str]:
+    if not path.exists():
+        return False, "missing-file"
+    html = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")
+    m = META_RE.search(html)
+    if not m:
+        return False, "missing-article-meta"
+    try:
+        meta = json.loads(m.group(2))
+    except json.JSONDecodeError:
+        return False, "invalid-article-meta-json"
+
+    for key in (
+        "section",
+        "sectionLabel",
+        "sectionHref",
+        "libraryKindKey",
+        "libraryKindLabel",
+        "cardBadgeLabel",
+        "topicLv1Key",
+        "topicLv1Label",
+        "topicLv2Key",
+        "topicLv2Label",
+        "topicLv3Key",
+        "topicLv3Label",
+        "cardTopicLabel",
+    ):
+        meta[key] = article.get(key) or ""
+    meta["sectionKey"] = article.get("section") or ""
+    meta["topicLabel"] = article.get("topicLv2Label") or article.get("topicLv1Label") or ""
+
+    replaced = html[: m.start(2)] + json.dumps(meta, ensure_ascii=False) + html[m.end(2) :]
+    path.write_text(replaced, encoding="utf-8")
+    return True, "updated"
+
+
+def rebuild(importer, data_articles: List[Dict]) -> Dict[str, int]:
+    records_by_section: Dict[str, List[Dict]] = {"thu-vien": [], "ban-tin": []}
+    for idx, item in enumerate(data_articles):
+        rec = {
+            "file": Path(item["href"]).name.replace(".html", ".htm"),
+            "target_root": item["href"],
+            "section": item["section"],
+            "title": item["title"],
+            "excerpt": item.get("excerpt") or "",
+            "content_html": "",
+            "topic_lv1_key": item.get("topicLv1Key") or "",
+            "topic_lv1_label": item.get("topicLv1Label") or "",
+            "topic_lv2_key": item.get("topicLv2Key") or "",
+            "topic_lv2_label": item.get("topicLv2Label") or "",
+            "topic_lv3_key": item.get("topicLv3Key") or "",
+            "topic_lv3_label": item.get("topicLv3Label") or "",
+            "tags": item.get("tags") or [],
+            "display_badge": item.get("cardBadgeLabel") or "",
+            "display_topic": item.get("cardTopicLabel") or "",
+            "library_kind_key": item.get("libraryKindKey") or "",
+            "library_kind_label": item.get("libraryKindLabel") or "",
+            "tool_lv3_key": item.get("toolLv3Key") or "",
+            "tool_lv3_label": item.get("toolLv3Label") or "",
+            "publish_date": item.get("publishDate") or "",
+            "modified_date": item.get("modifiedDate"),
+            "author_name": item.get("authorName") or "Kế Toán Diệu Tâm",
+            "author_type": item.get("authorType") or "Organization",
+            "hub_image": item.get("image") or importer.FEATURE_IMAGE_PATH,
+            "catalog_index": idx,
+        }
+        records_by_section[item["section"]].append(rec)
+
+    for sec in ("thu-vien", "ban-tin"):
+        records_by_section[sec].sort(key=lambda r: importer.fold(r["title"]))
+        for i, r in enumerate(records_by_section[sec]):
+            r["catalog_index"] = i
+
+    page_maps = {}
+    for sec in ("thu-vien", "ban-tin"):
+        total_pages = max(1, (len(records_by_section[sec]) + importer.PAGE_SIZE - 1) // importer.PAGE_SIZE)
+        page_maps[sec] = importer.build_page_map(sec, total_pages)
+
+    importer.rebuild_hub_pages(records_by_section, page_maps)
+    idx_data = importer.build_content_index(records_by_section)
+    importer.write_content_index(idx_data)
+    importer.write_data_artifacts(records_by_section, idx_data, page_maps)
+    importer.write_taxonomy_data(records_by_section)
+    importer.write_sitemap(idx_data, page_maps)
+    return {
+        "thu_vien_count": len(records_by_section["thu-vien"]),
+        "ban_tin_count": len(records_by_section["ban-tin"]),
+        "thu_vien_pages": len(page_maps["thu-vien"]),
+        "ban_tin_pages": len(page_maps["ban-tin"]),
+    }
+
+
+def main() -> None:

+    applied = []

+        if isinstance(article.get("classificationReasons"), dict):

+        ok, reason = update_meta(ROOT / href, article)

+)

+    "bieu-mau": "Biểu mẫu",

+}

+    "thu-vien/cach-ke-khai-thue-cho-chi-nhanh-hach-toan-phu-thuoc-va-doc-lap.html": {
+        "kind": "huong-dan",
+        "lv1": "thue",
+        "lv2": "gtgt-hoa-don",
+        "lv3": "ke-khai-gtgt",
+        "reason": "ke-khai-thue-chi-nhanh",
+    },
+}

+def load_importer_module():
+    module_path = ROOT / "tools" / "import_stage1_20.py"
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("importer_phase11_huongdan_ketoan_taikhoan", module_path)
+    if spec is None or spec.loader is None:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"Không import được module: {module_path}")
+    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    spec.loader.exec_module(module)  # type: ignore[attr-defined]

+def build_label_maps(articles: List[Dict]) -> Tuple[Dict[str, str], Dict[str, str], Dict[str, str]]:
+    lv1: Dict[str, str] = {}
+    lv2: Dict[str, str] = {}
+    lv3: Dict[str, str] = {}
+    for a in articles:
+        if a.get("topicLv1Key"):
+            lv1.setdefault(a["topicLv1Key"], a.get("topicLv1Label") or a["topicLv1Key"])
+        if a.get("topicLv2Key"):
+            lv2.setdefault(a["topicLv2Key"], a.get("topicLv2Label") or a["topicLv2Key"])
+        if a.get("topicLv3Key"):
+            lv3.setdefault(a["topicLv3Key"], a.get("topicLv3Label") or a["topicLv3Key"])
+    return lv1, lv2, lv3
+
+
+def update_meta(path: Path, article: Dict) -> Tuple[bool, str]:
+    if not path.exists():
+        return False, "missing-file"
+    html = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")
+    m = META_RE.search(html)
+    if not m:
+        return False, "missing-article-meta"
+    try:
+        meta = json.loads(m.group(2))
+    except json.JSONDecodeError:
+        return False, "invalid-article-meta-json"
+
+    for key in (
+        "section",
+        "sectionLabel",
+        "sectionHref",
+        "libraryKindKey",
+        "libraryKindLabel",
+        "cardBadgeLabel",
+        "topicLv1Key",
+        "topicLv1Label",
+        "topicLv2Key",
+        "topicLv2Label",
+        "topicLv3Key",
+        "topicLv3Label",
+        "cardTopicLabel",
+    ):
+        meta[key] = article.get(key) or ""
+    meta["sectionKey"] = article.get("section") or ""
+    meta["topicLabel"] = article.get("topicLv2Label") or article.get("topicLv1Label") or ""
+
+    replaced = html[: m.start(2)] + json.dumps(meta, ensure_ascii=False) + html[m.end(2) :]
+    path.write_text(replaced, encoding="utf-8")
+    return True, "updated"
+
+
+def rebuild(importer, data_articles: List[Dict]) -> Dict[str, int]:

+            "section": item["section"],
+            "title": item["title"],

+            "topic_lv2_label": item.get("topicLv2Label") or "",
+            "topic_lv3_key": item.get("topicLv3Key") or "",
+            "topic_lv3_label": item.get("topicLv3Label") or "",
+            "tags": item.get("tags") or [],
+            "display_badge": item.get("cardBadgeLabel") or "",
+            "display_topic": item.get("cardTopicLabel") or "",
+            "library_kind_key": item.get("libraryKindKey") or "",
+            "library_kind_label": item.get("libraryKindLabel") or "",
+            "tool_lv3_key": item.get("toolLv3Key") or "",
+            "tool_lv3_label": item.get("toolLv3Label") or "",

+        records_by_section[item["section"]].append(rec)
+
+    for sec in ("thu-vien", "ban-tin"):
+        records_by_section[sec].sort(key=lambda r: importer.fold(r["title"]))
+        for i, r in enumerate(records_by_section[sec]):
+            r["catalog_index"] = i
+
+    page_maps = {}
+    for sec in ("thu-vien", "ban-tin"):
+        total_pages = max(1, (len(records_by_section[sec]) + importer.PAGE_SIZE - 1) // importer.PAGE_SIZE)
+        page_maps[sec] = importer.build_page_map(sec, total_pages)
+
+    importer.rebuild_hub_pages(records_by_section, page_maps)
+    idx_data = importer.build_content_index(records_by_section)
+    importer.write_content_index(idx_data)
+    importer.write_data_artifacts(records_by_section, idx_data, page_maps)
+    importer.write_taxonomy_data(records_by_section)
+    importer.write_sitemap(idx_data, page_maps)
+    return {
+        "thu_vien_count": len(records_by_section["thu-vien"]),
+        "ban_tin_count": len(records_by_section["ban-tin"]),
+        "thu_vien_pages": len(page_maps["thu-vien"]),
+        "ban_tin_pages": len(page_maps["ban-tin"]),
+    }
+

+def main() -> None:

+            "lv1": article.get("topicLv1Key") or "",
+            "lv2": article.get("topicLv2Key") or "",

+        if isinstance(article.get("classificationReasons"), dict):

+
+        ok, reason = update_meta(ROOT / href, article)

+
+        applied.append(

+                "href": href,
+                "title": article.get("title") or "",
+                "reason": decision["reason"],
+                "before": before,
+                "after": {

+                    "lv1": article.get("topicLv1Key") or "",

+                    "lv3": article.get("topicLv3Key") or "",

+    counts = rebuild(importer, data_articles)

+    phase_bucket_after = [

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Phase 12: rà và sửa nhóm Hướng dẫn > Kế toán > Tài sản - Kho - CCDC."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import importlib.util
+import json
+import re
+from datetime import datetime
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Dict, List, Tuple
+
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
+OUT_JSON = ROOT / "docs" / "thu-vien-phase12-huong-dan-ke-toan-tai-san-kho-ccdc.json"
+OUT_MD = ROOT / "docs" / "thu-vien-phase12-huong-dan-ke-toan-tai-san-kho-ccdc.md"
+
+META_RE = re.compile(
+    r'(<script id="article-meta" type="application/json">)(.*?)(</script>)',
+    re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL,
+)
+TITLE_RE = re.compile(r"(<title>)(.*?)(</title>)", re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL)
+
+LIBRARY_KIND_LABELS = {
+    "huong-dan": "Hướng dẫn",
+    "bieu-mau": "Biểu mẫu",
+    "cong-cu": "Công cụ",
+    "van-ban": "Văn bản",
+}
+SECTION_LABELS = {
+    "thu-vien": ("Thư viện", "thu-vien.html"),
+    "ban-tin": ("Bản tin", "ban-tin.html"),
+}
+
+
+DECISIONS: Dict[str, Dict[str, str]] = {
+    # Chuẩn mực VAS để nhầm ở tài sản-kho-ccdc -> đưa về Chuẩn mực kế toán
+    "thu-vien/chuan-muc-ke-toan-so-02-hang-ton-kho.html": {
+        "section": "thu-vien",
+        "kind": "huong-dan",
+        "lv1": "ke-toan",
+        "lv2": "chuan-muc-che-do-nguyen-tac",
+        "lv3": "chuan-muc-ke-toan-vas",
+        "reason": "vas02-hang-ton-kho",
+    },
+    "thu-vien/chuan-muc-ke-toan-so-03-tai-san-co-dinh-huu-hinh.html": {
+        "section": "thu-vien",
+        "kind": "huong-dan",
+        "lv1": "ke-toan",
+        "lv2": "chuan-muc-che-do-nguyen-tac",
+        "lv3": "chuan-muc-ke-toan-vas",
+        "reason": "vas03-tscd-huu-hinh",
+    },
+    "thu-vien/chuan-muc-ke-toan-so-04-tai-san-co-dinh-vo-hinh.html": {
+        "section": "thu-vien",
+        "kind": "huong-dan",
+        "lv1": "ke-toan",
+        "lv2": "chuan-muc-che-do-nguyen-tac",
+        "lv3": "chuan-muc-ke-toan-vas",
+        "reason": "vas04-tscd-vo-hinh",
+    },
+    # Tin tuyển dụng lẫn vào hướng dẫn -> chuyển sang Bản tin / Thông báo tuyển dụng
+    "thu-vien/cong-ty-thien-vu-group-tuyen-nhan-vien-thu-kho-thu-quy.html": {
+        "section": "ban-tin",
+        "kind": "",
+        "lv1": "thong-bao-tuyen-dung",
+        "lv2": "",
+        "lv3": "",
+        "reason": "job-post-thu-kho-thu-quy",
+    },
+    # Bài mô tả nghề nghiệp -> nhóm tham khảo học liệu
+    "thu-vien/cong-viec-cua-nhan-vien-ke-toan-kho-phai-lam.html": {
+        "section": "thu-vien",
+        "kind": "huong-dan",
+        "lv1": "tham-khao-hoc-lieu",
+        "lv2": "kinh-nghiem-hoi-dap-nghe-nghiep",
+        "lv3": "mo-ta-cong-viec-ke-toan",
+        "reason": "mo-ta-cong-viec-ke-toan-kho",
+    },
+}
+
+
+def load_importer_module():
+    module_path = ROOT / "tools" / "import_stage1_20.py"
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("importer_phase12_huongdan_ke_toan_taisan", module_path)
+    if spec is None or spec.loader is None:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"Không import được module: {module_path}")
+    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    spec.loader.exec_module(module)  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+    return module
+
+
+def build_label_maps(articles: List[Dict]) -> Tuple[Dict[str, str], Dict[str, str], Dict[str, str]]:
+    lv1: Dict[str, str] = {}
+    lv2: Dict[str, str] = {}
+    lv3: Dict[str, str] = {}
+    for a in articles:
+        if a.get("topicLv1Key"):
+            lv1.setdefault(a["topicLv1Key"], a.get("topicLv1Label") or a["topicLv1Key"])
+        if a.get("topicLv2Key"):
+            lv2.setdefault(a["topicLv2Key"], a.get("topicLv2Label") or a["topicLv2Key"])
+        if a.get("topicLv3Key"):
+            lv3.setdefault(a["topicLv3Key"], a.get("topicLv3Label") or a["topicLv3Key"])
+    return lv1, lv2, lv3
+
+
+def update_html_meta_and_title(path: Path, article: Dict) -> Tuple[bool, str]:
+    if not path.exists():
+        return False, "missing-file"
+    html = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")
+
+    m = META_RE.search(html)
+    if not m:
+        return False, "missing-article-meta"
+    try:
+        meta = json.loads(m.group(2))
+    except json.JSONDecodeError:
+        return False, "invalid-article-meta-json"
+
+    for key in (
+        "section",
+        "sectionLabel",
+        "sectionHref",
+        "libraryKindKey",
+        "libraryKindLabel",
+        "cardBadgeLabel",
+        "topicLv1Key",
+        "topicLv1Label",
+        "topicLv2Key",
+        "topicLv2Label",
+        "topicLv3Key",
+        "topicLv3Label",
+        "cardTopicLabel",
+    ):
+        meta[key] = article.get(key) or ""
+    meta["sectionKey"] = article.get("section") or ""
+    meta["topicLabel"] = article.get("topicLv2Label") or article.get("topicLv1Label") or ""
+
+    replaced = html[: m.start(2)] + json.dumps(meta, ensure_ascii=False) + html[m.end(2) :]
+
+    title_new = f"{(article.get('title') or '').strip()} | {article['sectionLabel']} | Kế Toán Diệu Tâm"
+    t = TITLE_RE.search(replaced)
+    if t:
+        replaced = replaced[: t.start(2)] + title_new + replaced[t.end(2) :]
+
+    path.write_text(replaced, encoding="utf-8")
+    return True, "updated"
+
+
+def rebuild(importer, data_articles: List[Dict]) -> Dict[str, int]:
+    records_by_section: Dict[str, List[Dict]] = {"thu-vien": [], "ban-tin": []}

+def build_label_maps(articles: List[Dict]) -> Tuple[Dict[str, str], Dict[str, str], Dict[str, str]]:
+    lv1: Dict[str, str] = {}
+    lv2: Dict[str, str] = {}
+    lv3: Dict[str, str] = {}
+    for a in articles:
+        if a.get("topicLv1Key"):
+            lv1.setdefault(a["topicLv1Key"], a.get("topicLv1Label") or a["topicLv1Key"])
+        if a.get("topicLv2Key"):
+            lv2.setdefault(a["topicLv2Key"], a.get("topicLv2Label") or a["topicLv2Key"])
+        if a.get("topicLv3Key"):
+            lv3.setdefault(a["topicLv3Key"], a.get("topicLv3Label") or a["topicLv3Key"])
+    return lv1, lv2, lv3
+
+
+def update_meta(path: Path, article: Dict) -> Tuple[bool, str]:
+    if not path.exists():
+        return False, "missing-file"
+    html = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")
+    m = META_RE.search(html)
+    if not m:
+        return False, "missing-article-meta"
+    try:
+        meta = json.loads(m.group(2))
+    except json.JSONDecodeError:
+        return False, "invalid-article-meta-json"
+
+    for key in (
+        "section",
+        "sectionLabel",
+        "sectionHref",
+        "libraryKindKey",
+        "libraryKindLabel",
+        "cardBadgeLabel",
+        "topicLv1Key",
+        "topicLv1Label",
+        "topicLv2Key",
+        "topicLv2Label",
+        "topicLv3Key",
+        "topicLv3Label",
+        "cardTopicLabel",
+    ):
+        meta[key] = article.get(key) or ""
+    meta["sectionKey"] = article.get("section") or ""
+    meta["topicLabel"] = article.get("topicLv2Label") or article.get("topicLv1Label") or ""
+
+    replaced = html[: m.start(2)] + json.dumps(meta, ensure_ascii=False) + html[m.end(2) :]
+    path.write_text(replaced, encoding="utf-8")
+    return True, "updated"
+
+
+def rebuild(importer, data_articles: List[Dict]) -> Dict[str, int]:
+    records_by_section: Dict[str, List[Dict]] = {"thu-vien": [], "ban-tin": []}
+    for idx, item in enumerate(data_articles):
+        rec = {
+            "file": Path(item["href"]).name.replace(".html", ".htm"),
+            "target_root": item["href"],
+            "section": item["section"],
+            "title": item["title"],
+            "excerpt": item.get("excerpt") or "",
+            "content_html": "",
+            "topic_lv1_key": item.get("topicLv1Key") or "",
+            "topic_lv1_label": item.get("topicLv1Label") or "",
+            "topic_lv2_key": item.get("topicLv2Key") or "",
+            "topic_lv2_label": item.get("topicLv2Label") or "",
+            "topic_lv3_key": item.get("topicLv3Key") or "",
+            "topic_lv3_label": item.get("topicLv3Label") or "",
+            "tags": item.get("tags") or [],
+            "display_badge": item.get("cardBadgeLabel") or "",
+            "display_topic": item.get("cardTopicLabel") or "",
+            "library_kind_key": item.get("libraryKindKey") or "",
+            "library_kind_label": item.get("libraryKindLabel") or "",
+            "tool_lv3_key": item.get("toolLv3Key") or "",
+            "tool_lv3_label": item.get("toolLv3Label") or "",
+            "publish_date": item.get("publishDate") or "",
+            "modified_date": item.get("modifiedDate"),
+            "author_name": item.get("authorName") or "Kế Toán Diệu Tâm",
+            "author_type": item.get("authorType") or "Organization",
+            "hub_image": item.get("image") or importer.FEATURE_IMAGE_PATH,
+            "catalog_index": idx,
+        }
+        records_by_section[item["section"]].append(rec)
+
+    for sec in ("thu-vien", "ban-tin"):
+        records_by_section[sec].sort(key=lambda r: importer.fold(r["title"]))
+        for i, r in enumerate(records_by_section[sec]):
+            r["catalog_index"] = i
+
+    page_maps = {}
+    for sec in ("thu-vien", "ban-tin"):
+        total_pages = max(1, (len(records_by_section[sec]) + importer.PAGE_SIZE - 1) // importer.PAGE_SIZE)
+        page_maps[sec] = importer.build_page_map(sec, total_pages)
+
+    importer.rebuild_hub_pages(records_by_section, page_maps)
+    idx_data = importer.build_content_index(records_by_section)
+    importer.write_content_index(idx_data)
+    importer.write_data_artifacts(records_by_section, idx_data, page_maps)
+    importer.write_taxonomy_data(records_by_section)
+    importer.write_sitemap(idx_data, page_maps)
+    return {
+        "thu_vien_count": len(records_by_section["thu-vien"]),
+        "ban_tin_count": len(records_by_section["ban-tin"]),
+        "thu_vien_pages": len(page_maps["thu-vien"]),
+        "ban_tin_pages": len(page_maps["ban-tin"]),
+    }
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    importer = load_importer_module()
+    data_articles_path = importer.DATA_DIR / "articles.json"
+    data_articles: List[Dict] = importer.read_json(data_articles_path)
+    article_map = {a["href"]: a for a in data_articles}
+    lv1_labels, lv2_labels, lv3_labels = build_label_maps(data_articles)
+
+    applied = []
+    skipped = []
+    for href, decision in DECISIONS.items():
+        article = article_map.get(href)
+        if not article:
+            skipped.append({"href": href, "reason": "missing-article"})
+            continue
+
+        kind = decision["kind"]
+        lv1 = decision["lv1"]
+        lv2 = decision["lv2"]
+        lv3 = decision["lv3"]
+        if kind not in LIBRARY_KIND_LABELS or lv1 not in lv1_labels or lv2 not in lv2_labels or lv3 not in lv3_labels:
+            skipped.append({"href": href, "reason": "missing-target-label", "decision": decision})
+            continue
+
+        before = {
+            "kind": article.get("libraryKindKey") or "",
+            "lv1": article.get("topicLv1Key") or "",
+            "lv2": article.get("topicLv2Key") or "",
+            "lv3": article.get("topicLv3Key") or "",
+        }
+
+        article["section"] = "thu-vien"
+        article["sectionLabel"] = "Thư viện"
+        article["sectionHref"] = "thu-vien.html"
+        article["libraryKindKey"] = kind
+        article["libraryKindLabel"] = LIBRARY_KIND_LABELS[kind]
+        article["cardBadgeLabel"] = LIBRARY_KIND_LABELS[kind]
+        article["topicLv1Key"] = lv1
+        article["topicLv1Label"] = lv1_labels[lv1]
+        article["topicLv2Key"] = lv2
+        article["topicLv2Label"] = lv2_labels[lv2]
+        article["topicLv3Key"] = lv3
+        article["topicLv3Label"] = lv3_labels[lv3]
+        article["cardTopicLabel"] = article["topicLv2Label"]
+        if isinstance(article.get("classificationReasons"), dict):
+            article["classificationReasons"]["phase13ThuVienKeToanTaiSanKhoCCDCForms"] = decision["reason"]
+
+        ok, reason = update_meta(ROOT / href, article)
+        if not ok:
+            skipped.append({"href": href, "reason": reason})
+            continue
+
+        applied.append(
+            {
+                "href": href,
+                "title": article.get("title") or "",
+                "reason": decision["reason"],
+                "before": before,
+                "after": {
+                    "kind": article.get("libraryKindKey") or "",
+                    "lv1": article.get("topicLv1Key") or "",
+                    "lv2": article.get("topicLv2Key") or "",
+                    "lv3": article.get("topicLv3Key") or "",
+                },
+            }
+        )
+
+    importer.write_json(data_articles_path, data_articles)
+    counts = rebuild(importer, data_articles)
+
+    phase_bucket_after = [
+        a for a in data_articles
+        if a.get("section") == "thu-vien"
+        and a.get("libraryKindKey") == "huong-dan"
+        and a.get("topicLv1Key") == "ke-toan"
+        and a.get("topicLv2Key") == "tai-san-kho-ccdc"
+    ]
+
+    payload = {
+        "generatedAt": datetime.now().isoformat(),
+        "phase": "phase13-huong-dan-ke-toan-tai-san-kho-ccdc-forms",
+        "appliedCount": len(applied),
+        "skippedCount": len(skipped),
+        "applied": applied,
+        "skipped": skipped,
+        "after": {
+            "remainingInBucket": len(phase_bucket_after),
+            "countsAfterRebuild": counts,
+        },
+        "deferredManualReview": [
+            {
+                "href": "thu-vien/trich-lap-quy-phat-trien-khoa-hoc-va-cong-nghe-cua-dn.html",
+                "reason": "chinh-sach-thue-vs-hach-toan-dac-thu",
+            }
+        ],
+    }
+    OUT_JSON.write_text(json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+
+    lines = [
+        "# Phase 13 - Rà soát Hướng dẫn / Kế toán / Tài sản - Kho - CCDC (nhóm biểu mẫu/sổ)",
+        "",
+        f"- Thời gian chạy: `{datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')}`",
+        f"- Applied: **{len(applied)}**",
+        f"- Skipped: **{len(skipped)}**",
+        f"- Còn lại trong bucket sau phase 13: **{len(phase_bucket_after)}**",
+        f"- Rebuild: Thư viện {counts['thu_vien_count']} bài / {counts['thu_vien_pages']} trang; Bản tin {counts['ban_tin_count']} bài / {counts['ban_tin_pages']} trang",
+        "",
+        "## Các bài đã chỉnh",
+        "",
+        "| # | href | before | after | reason |",
+        "|---:|---|---|---|---|",
+    ]
+    for i, row in enumerate(applied, 1):
+        b = row["before"]
+        a = row["after"]
+        lines.append(
+            f"| {i} | `{row['href']}` | `{b['kind']} / {b['lv1']} / {b['lv2']} / {b['lv3']}` | `{a['kind']} / {a['lv1']} / {a['lv2']} / {a['lv3']}` | `{row['reason']}` |"
+        )
+    if skipped:
+        lines += ["", "## Skipped", ""]
+        for row in skipped:
+            lines.append(f"- `{row['href']}`: {row['reason']}")
+    lines += [
+        "",
+        "## Deferred manual review",
+        "",
+        "- `thu-vien/trich-lap-quy-phat-trien-khoa-hoc-va-cong-nghe-cua-dn.html`",
+    ]
+    OUT_MD.write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+
+    print(
+        json.dumps(
+            {
+                "applied": len(applied),
+                "skipped": len(skipped),
+                "remainingInBucket": len(phase_bucket_after),
+                "report": str(OUT_MD.relative_to(ROOT)),
+            },
+            ensure_ascii=False,
+            indent=2,
+        )
+    )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Phase 14: tinh chỉnh lv3 nội bộ cho Hướng dẫn > Kế toán > Tài sản - Kho - CCDC."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import importlib.util
+import json
+import re
+from datetime import datetime
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Dict, List, Tuple
+
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
+OUT_JSON = ROOT / "docs" / "thu-vien-phase14-huong-dan-ke-toan-tai-san-kho-ccdc-lv3-refine.json"
+OUT_MD = ROOT / "docs" / "thu-vien-phase14-huong-dan-ke-toan-tai-san-kho-ccdc-lv3-refine.md"
+
+META_RE = re.compile(
+    r'(<script id="article-meta" type="application/json">)(.*?)(</script>)',
+    re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL,
+)
+
+LIBRARY_KIND_LABELS = {
+    "huong-dan": "Hướng dẫn",
+    "bieu-mau": "Biểu mẫu",
+    "cong-cu": "Công cụ",
+    "van-ban": "Văn bản",
+}
+
+
+DECISIONS: Dict[str, Dict[str, str]] = {
+    # Các bài TSCĐ/khấu hao/nguyên giá đang nằm sai ở lv3 hàng tồn kho
+    "thu-vien/cach-tinh-khau-hao-tai-san-co-dinh-da-qua-su-dung.html": {
+        "kind": "huong-dan",
+        "lv1": "ke-toan",
+        "lv2": "tai-san-kho-ccdc",
+        "lv3": "tscd-nguyen-gia-khau-hao",
+        "reason": "khau-hao-tscd-da-qua-su-dung",
+    },
+    "thu-vien/cach-phan-biet-tai-san-co-dinh-va-cong-cu-dung-cu.html": {
+        "kind": "huong-dan",
+        "lv1": "ke-toan",
+        "lv2": "tai-san-kho-ccdc",
+        "lv3": "tscd-nguyen-gia-khau-hao",
+        "reason": "phan-biet-tscd-va-ccdc",
+    },
+    "thu-vien/cach-trich-khau-hao-tai-san-co-dinh-theo-so-du-giam-dan.html": {
+        "kind": "huong-dan",
+        "lv1": "ke-toan",
+        "lv2": "tai-san-kho-ccdc",
+        "lv3": "tscd-nguyen-gia-khau-hao",
+        "reason": "khau-hao-so-du-giam-dan",
+    },
+    "thu-vien/cach-xac-dinh-nguyen-gia-tai-san-co-dinh-vo-hinh.html": {
+        "kind": "huong-dan",
+        "lv1": "ke-toan",
+        "lv2": "tai-san-kho-ccdc",
+        "lv3": "tscd-nguyen-gia-khau-hao",
+        "reason": "nguyen-gia-tscd-vo-hinh-thue-tai-chinh",
+    },
+    "thu-vien/cach-xac-dinh-thoi-gian-trich-khau-hao-tai-san-co-dinh.html": {
+        "kind": "huong-dan",
+        "lv1": "ke-toan",
+        "lv2": "tai-san-kho-ccdc",
+        "lv3": "tscd-nguyen-gia-khau-hao",
+        "reason": "thoi-gian-trich-khau-hao-tscd",
+    },
+    "thu-vien/quy-dinh-phuong-phap-trich-khau-hao-nhanh-tscd.html": {
+        "kind": "huong-dan",
+        "lv1": "ke-toan",
+        "lv2": "tai-san-kho-ccdc",
+        "lv3": "tscd-nguyen-gia-khau-hao",
+        "reason": "khau-hao-nhanh-tscd",
+    },
+    "thu-vien/dieu-kien-ghi-nhan-tai-san-co-dinh-moi-nhat.html": {
+        "kind": "huong-dan",
+        "lv1": "ke-toan",
+        "lv2": "tai-san-kho-ccdc",
+        "lv3": "tscd-nguyen-gia-khau-hao",
+        "reason": "dieu-kien-ghi-nhan-tscd",
+    },
+    # Bài phân bổ CCDC phù hợp lv3 hàng tồn kho/CCDC hơn
+    "thu-vien/huong-dan-cach-tinh-phan-bo-cong-cu-dung-cu.html": {
+        "kind": "huong-dan",
+        "lv1": "ke-toan",
+        "lv2": "tai-san-kho-ccdc",
+        "lv3": "hang-ton-kho-gia-xuat",
+        "reason": "phan-bo-ccdc",
+    },
+}
+
+
+def load_importer_module():
+    module_path = ROOT / "tools" / "import_stage1_20.py"
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("importer_phase14_huongdan_ketoan_taisan_lv3", module_path)
+    if spec is None or spec.loader is None:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"Không import được module: {module_path}")
+    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    spec.loader.exec_module(module)  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+    return module
+
+
+def build_label_maps(articles: List[Dict]) -> Tuple[Dict[str, str], Dict[str, str], Dict[str, str]]:
+    lv1: Dict[str, str] = {}
+    lv2: Dict[str, str] = {}
+    lv3: Dict[str, str] = {}
+    for a in articles:
+        if a.get("topicLv1Key"):
+            lv1.setdefault(a["topicLv1Key"], a.get("topicLv1Label") or a["topicLv1Key"])
+        if a.get("topicLv2Key"):
+            lv2.setdefault(a["topicLv2Key"], a.get("topicLv2Label") or a["topicLv2Key"])
+        if a.get("topicLv3Key"):
+            lv3.setdefault(a["topicLv3Key"], a.get("topicLv3Label") or a["topicLv3Key"])
+    return lv1, lv2, lv3
+
+
+def update_meta(path: Path, article: Dict) -> Tuple[bool, str]:
+    if not path.exists():
+        return False, "missing-file"
+    html = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")
+    m = META_RE.search(html)
+    if not m:
+        return False, "missing-article-meta"
+    try:
+        meta = json.loads(m.group(2))
+    except json.JSONDecodeError:
+        return False, "invalid-article-meta-json"
+
+    for key in (
+        "section",
+        "sectionLabel",
+        "sectionHref",
+        "libraryKindKey",
+        "libraryKindLabel",
+        "cardBadgeLabel",
+        "topicLv1Key",
+        "topicLv1Label",
+        "topicLv2Key",
+        "topicLv2Label",
+        "topicLv3Key",
+        "topicLv3Label",
+        "cardTopicLabel",
+    ):
+        meta[key] = article.get(key) or ""
+    meta["sectionKey"] = article.get("section") or ""
+    meta["topicLabel"] = article.get("topicLv2Label") or article.get("topicLv1Label") or ""
+
+    replaced = html[: m.start(2)] + json.dumps(meta, ensure_ascii=False) + html[m.end(2) :]
+    path.write_text(replaced, encoding="utf-8")
+    return True, "updated"
+
+
+def rebuild(importer, data_articles: List[Dict]) -> Dict[str, int]:
+    records_by_section: Dict[str, List[Dict]] = {"thu-vien": [], "ban-tin": []}
+    for idx, item in enumerate(data_articles):
+        rec = {
+            "file": Path(item["href"]).name.replace(".html", ".htm"),
+            "target_root": item["href"],
+            "section": item["section"],
+            "title": item["title"],
+            "excerpt": item.get("excerpt") or "",
+            "content_html": "",
+            "topic_lv1_key": item.get("topicLv1Key") or "",
+            "topic_lv1_label": item.get("topicLv1Label") or "",
+            "topic_lv2_key": item.get("topicLv2Key") or "",
+            "topic_lv2_label": item.get("topicLv2Label") or "",
+            "topic_lv3_key": item.get("topicLv3Key") or "",
+            "topic_lv3_label": item.get("topicLv3Label") or "",
+            "tags": item.get("tags") or [],
+            "display_badge": item.get("cardBadgeLabel") or "",
+            "display_topic": item.get("cardTopicLabel") or "",
+            "library_kind_key": item.get("libraryKindKey") or "",
+            "library_kind_label": item.get("libraryKindLabel") or "",
+            "tool_lv3_key": item.get("toolLv3Key") or "",
+            "tool_lv3_label": item.get("toolLv3Label") or "",
+            "publish_date": item.get("publishDate") or "",
+            "modified_date": item.get("modifiedDate"),
+            "author_name": item.get("authorName") or "Kế Toán Diệu Tâm",
+            "author_type": item.get("authorType") or "Organization",
+            "hub_image": item.get("image") or importer.FEATURE_IMAGE_PATH,
+            "catalog_index": idx,
+        }
+        records_by_section[item["section"]].append(rec)
+
+    for sec in ("thu-vien", "ban-tin"):
+        records_by_section[sec].sort(key=lambda r: importer.fold(r["title"]))
+        for i, r in enumerate(records_by_section[sec]):
+            r["catalog_index"] = i
+
+    page_maps = {}
+    for sec in ("thu-vien", "ban-tin"):
+        total_pages = max(1, (len(records_by_section[sec]) + importer.PAGE_SIZE - 1) // importer.PAGE_SIZE)
+        page_maps[sec] = importer.build_page_map(sec, total_pages)
+
+    importer.rebuild_hub_pages(records_by_section, page_maps)
+    idx_data = importer.build_content_index(records_by_section)
+    importer.write_content_index(idx_data)
+    importer.write_data_artifacts(records_by_section, idx_data, page_maps)
+    importer.write_taxonomy_data(records_by_section)
+    importer.write_sitemap(idx_data, page_maps)
+    return {
+        "thu_vien_count": len(records_by_section["thu-vien"]),
+        "ban_tin_count": len(records_by_section["ban-tin"]),
+        "thu_vien_pages": len(page_maps["thu-vien"]),
+        "ban_tin_pages": len(page_maps["ban-tin"]),
+    }
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    importer = load_importer_module()
+    data_articles_path = importer.DATA_DIR / "articles.json"
+    data_articles: List[Dict] = importer.read_json(data_articles_path)
+    article_map = {a["href"]: a for a in data_articles}
+    lv1_labels, lv2_labels, lv3_labels = build_label_maps(data_articles)
+
+    applied = []
+    skipped = []
+    for href, decision in DECISIONS.items():
+        article = article_map.get(href)
+        if not article:
+            skipped.append({"href": href, "reason": "missing-article"})
+            continue
+
+        kind = decision["kind"]
+        lv1 = decision["lv1"]
+        lv2 = decision["lv2"]
+        lv3 = decision["lv3"]
+        if kind not in LIBRARY_KIND_LABELS or lv1 not in lv1_labels or lv2 not in lv2_labels or lv3 not in lv3_labels:
+            skipped.append({"href": href, "reason": "missing-target-label", "decision": decision})
+            continue
+
+        before = {
+            "kind": article.get("libraryKindKey") or "",
+            "lv1": article.get("topicLv1Key") or "",
+            "lv2": article.get("topicLv2Key") or "",
+            "lv3": article.get("topicLv3Key") or "",
+        }
+
+        article["section"] = "thu-vien"
+        article["sectionLabel"] = "Thư viện"
+        article["sectionHref"] = "thu-vien.html"
+        article["libraryKindKey"] = kind
+        article["libraryKindLabel"] = LIBRARY_KIND_LABELS[kind]
+        article["cardBadgeLabel"] = LIBRARY_KIND_LABELS[kind]
+        article["topicLv1Key"] = lv1
+        article["topicLv1Label"] = lv1_labels[lv1]
+        article["topicLv2Key"] = lv2
+        article["topicLv2Label"] = lv2_labels[lv2]
+        article["topicLv3Key"] = lv3
+        article["topicLv3Label"] = lv3_labels[lv3]
+        article["cardTopicLabel"] = article["topicLv2Label"]
+        if isinstance(article.get("classificationReasons"), dict):
+            article["classificationReasons"]["phase14ThuVienKeToanTaiSanKhoCCDCRefine"] = decision["reason"]
+
+        ok, reason = update_meta(ROOT / href, article)
+        if not ok:
+            skipped.append({"href": href, "reason": reason})
+            continue
+
+        applied.append(
+            {
+                "href": href,
+                "title": article.get("title") or "",
+                "reason": decision["reason"],
+                "before": before,
+                "after": {
+                    "kind": article.get("libraryKindKey") or "",
+                    "lv1": article.get("topicLv1Key") or "",
+                    "lv2": article.get("topicLv2Key") or "",
+                    "lv3": article.get("topicLv3Key") or "",
+                },
+            }
+        )
+
+    importer.write_json(data_articles_path, data_articles)
+    counts = rebuild(importer, data_articles)
+
+    phase_bucket_after = [
+        a for a in data_articles
+        if a.get("section") == "thu-vien"
+        and a.get("libraryKindKey") == "huong-dan"
+        and a.get("topicLv1Key") == "ke-toan"
+        and a.get("topicLv2Key") == "tai-san-kho-ccdc"
+    ]
+
+    payload = {
+        "generatedAt": datetime.now().isoformat(),
+        "phase": "phase14-huong-dan-ke-toan-tai-san-kho-ccdc-lv3-refine",
+        "appliedCount": len(applied),
+        "skippedCount": len(skipped),
+        "applied": applied,
+        "skipped": skipped,
+        "after": {
+            "remainingInBucket": len(phase_bucket_after),
+            "countsAfterRebuild": counts,
+        },
+        "deferredManualReview": [
+            {
+                "href": "thu-vien/trich-lap-quy-phat-trien-khoa-hoc-va-cong-nghe-cua-dn.html",
+                "reason": "canh-gioi-chinh-sach-thue-vs-ke-toan",
+            },
+            {
+                "href": "thu-vien/quy-dinh-ve-viec-kiem-ke-tai-san-hang-nam.html",
+                "reason": "canh-gioi-chuan-muc-vs-nghiep-vu-kho",
+            },
+        ],
+    }
+    OUT_JSON.write_text(json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+
+    lines = [
+        "# Phase 14 - Tinh chỉnh lv3 Hướng dẫn / Kế toán / Tài sản - Kho - CCDC",
+        "",
+        f"- Thời gian chạy: `{datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')}`",
+        f"- Applied: **{len(applied)}**",
+        f"- Skipped: **{len(skipped)}**",
+        f"- Còn lại trong bucket sau phase 14: **{len(phase_bucket_after)}**",
+        f"- Rebuild: Thư viện {counts['thu_vien_count']} bài / {counts['thu_vien_pages']} trang; Bản tin {counts['ban_tin_count']} bài / {counts['ban_tin_pages']} trang",
+        "",
+        "## Các bài đã chỉnh",
+        "",
+        "| # | href | before | after | reason |",
+        "|---:|---|---|---|---|",
+    ]
+    for i, row in enumerate(applied, 1):
+        b = row["before"]
+        a = row["after"]
+        lines.append(
+            f"| {i} | `{row['href']}` | `{b['kind']} / {b['lv1']} / {b['lv2']} / {b['lv3']}` | `{a['kind']} / {a['lv1']} / {a['lv2']} / {a['lv3']}` | `{row['reason']}` |"
+        )
+    if skipped:
+        lines += ["", "## Skipped", ""]
+        for row in skipped:
+            lines.append(f"- `{row['href']}`: {row['reason']}")
+    lines += [
+        "",
+        "## Deferred manual review",
+        "",
+        "- `thu-vien/trich-lap-quy-phat-trien-khoa-hoc-va-cong-nghe-cua-dn.html`",
+        "- `thu-vien/quy-dinh-ve-viec-kiem-ke-tai-san-hang-nam.html`",
+    ]
+    OUT_MD.write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+
+    print(
+        json.dumps(
+            {
+                "applied": len(applied),
+                "skipped": len(skipped),
+                "remainingInBucket": len(phase_bucket_after),
+                "report": str(OUT_MD.relative_to(ROOT)),
+            },
+            ensure_ascii=False,
+            indent=2,
+        )
+    )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch

+def load_importer_module():
+    module_path = ROOT / "tools" / "import_stage1_20.py"
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("importer_phase16_batch50", module_path)
+    if spec is None or spec.loader is None:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"Không import được module: {module_path}")
+    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    spec.loader.exec_module(module)  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+    return module
+
+
+def build_label_maps(articles: List[Dict]) -> Tuple[Dict[str, str], Dict[str, str], Dict[str, str]]:
+    lv1: Dict[str, str] = {}
+    lv2: Dict[str, str] = {}
+    lv3: Dict[str, str] = {}
+    for a in articles:
+        if a.get("topicLv1Key"):
+            lv1.setdefault(a["topicLv1Key"], a.get("topicLv1Label") or a["topicLv1Key"])
+        if a.get("topicLv2Key"):
+            lv2.setdefault(a["topicLv2Key"], a.get("topicLv2Label") or a["topicLv2Key"])
+        if a.get("topicLv3Key"):
+            lv3.setdefault(a["topicLv3Key"], a.get("topicLv3Label") or a["topicLv3Key"])
+    return lv1, lv2, lv3
+
+
+def update_meta(path: Path, article: Dict) -> Tuple[bool, str]:
+    if not path.exists():
+        return False, "missing-file"
+    html = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")
+    m = META_RE.search(html)
+    if not m:
+        return False, "missing-article-meta"
+    try:
+        meta = json.loads(m.group(2))
+    except json.JSONDecodeError:
+        return False, "invalid-article-meta-json"
+
+    for key in (
+        "section",
+        "sectionLabel",
+        "sectionHref",
+        "libraryKindKey",
+        "libraryKindLabel",
+        "cardBadgeLabel",
+        "topicLv1Key",
+        "topicLv1Label",
+        "topicLv2Key",
+        "topicLv2Label",
+        "topicLv3Key",
+        "topicLv3Label",
+        "cardTopicLabel",
+    ):
+        meta[key] = article.get(key) or ""
+    meta["sectionKey"] = article.get("section") or ""
+    meta["topicLabel"] = article.get("topicLv2Label") or article.get("topicLv1Label") or ""
+
+    replaced = html[: m.start(2)] + json.dumps(meta, ensure_ascii=False) + html[m.end(2) :]
+    path.write_text(replaced, encoding="utf-8")
+    return True, "updated"
+
+
+def rebuild(importer, data_articles: List[Dict]) -> Dict[str, int]:
+    records_by_section: Dict[str, List[Dict]] = {"thu-vien": [], "ban-tin": []}
+    for idx, item in enumerate(data_articles):
+        rec = {
+            "file": Path(item["href"]).name.replace(".html", ".htm"),
+            "target_root": item["href"],
+            "section": item["section"],
+            "title": item["title"],
+            "excerpt": item.get("excerpt") or "",
+            "content_html": "",
+            "topic_lv1_key": item.get("topicLv1Key") or "",
+            "topic_lv1_label": item.get("topicLv1Label") or "",
+            "topic_lv2_key": item.get("topicLv2Key") or "",
+            "topic_lv2_label": item.get("topicLv2Label") or "",
+            "topic_lv3_key": item.get("topicLv3Key") or "",
+            "topic_lv3_label": item.get("topicLv3Label") or "",
+            "tags": item.get("tags") or [],
+            "display_badge": item.get("cardBadgeLabel") or "",
+            "display_topic": item.get("cardTopicLabel") or "",
+            "library_kind_key": item.get("libraryKindKey") or "",
+            "library_kind_label": item.get("libraryKindLabel") or "",
+            "tool_lv3_key": item.get("toolLv3Key") or "",
+            "tool_lv3_label": item.get("toolLv3Label") or "",
+            "publish_date": item.get("publishDate") or "",
+            "modified_date": item.get("modifiedDate"),
+            "author_name": item.get("authorName") or "Kế Toán Diệu Tâm",
+            "author_type": item.get("authorType") or "Organization",
+            "hub_image": item.get("image") or importer.FEATURE_IMAGE_PATH,
+            "catalog_index": idx,
+        }
+        records_by_section[item["section"]].append(rec)
+
+    for sec in ("thu-vien", "ban-tin"):
+        records_by_section[sec].sort(key=lambda r: importer.fold(r["title"]))
+        for i, r in enumerate(records_by_section[sec]):
+            r["catalog_index"] = i
+
+    page_maps = {}
+    for sec in ("thu-vien", "ban-tin"):
+        total_pages = max(1, (len(records_by_section[sec]) + importer.PAGE_SIZE - 1) // importer.PAGE_SIZE)
+        page_maps[sec] = importer.build_page_map(sec, total_pages)
+
+    importer.rebuild_hub_pages(records_by_section, page_maps)
+    idx_data = importer.build_content_index(records_by_section)
+    importer.write_content_index(idx_data)
+    importer.write_data_artifacts(records_by_section, idx_data, page_maps)
+    importer.write_taxonomy_data(records_by_section)
+    importer.write_sitemap(idx_data, page_maps)
+    return {
+        "thu_vien_count": len(records_by_section["thu-vien"]),
+        "ban_tin_count": len(records_by_section["ban-tin"]),
+        "thu_vien_pages": len(page_maps["thu-vien"]),
+        "ban_tin_pages": len(page_maps["ban-tin"]),
+    }
+
+
+def build_decisions(data_articles: List[Dict]) -> Dict[str, Dict[str, str]]:
+    decisions: Dict[str, Dict[str, str]] = {}
+
+    # 46 bài: từ van-ban/ke-toan sang huong-dan (giữ lv2/lv3, trừ override)
+    base_rows = [
+        a for a in data_articles
+        if a.get("section") == "thu-vien"
+        and a.get("libraryKindKey") == "van-ban"
+        and a.get("topicLv1Key") == "ke-toan"
+        and a["href"] not in EXCLUDE_VAN_BAN_KE_TOAN
+    ]
+    for a in sorted(base_rows, key=lambda x: x["href"]):
+        href = a["href"]
+        if href in OVERRIDES:
+            decisions[href] = dict(OVERRIDES[href])
+            continue
+        decisions[href] = {
+            "kind": "huong-dan",
+            "lv1": "ke-toan",
+            "lv2": a.get("topicLv2Key") or "",
+            "lv3": a.get("topicLv3Key") or "",
+            "reason": "phase16-vb-ke-toan-to-huong-dan",
+        }
+
+    # +4 bài nghị định lạc bucket
+    for href, decision in EXTRA_MOVES.items():
+        decisions[href] = dict(decision)
+
+    return decisions
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    importer = load_importer_module()
+    data_articles_path = importer.DATA_DIR / "articles.json"
+    data_articles: List[Dict] = importer.read_json(data_articles_path)
+    article_map = {a["href"]: a for a in data_articles}
+    lv1_labels, lv2_labels, lv3_labels = build_label_maps(data_articles)
+    decisions = build_decisions(data_articles)
+
+    if len(decisions) != 50:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"Phase16 cần đúng 50 bài, hiện build được {len(decisions)}")
+
+    applied = []
+    skipped = []
+    for href, decision in decisions.items():
+        article = article_map.get(href)
+        if not article:
+            skipped.append({"href": href, "reason": "missing-article"})
+            continue
+
+        kind = decision["kind"]
+        lv1 = decision["lv1"]
+        lv2 = decision["lv2"]
+        lv3 = decision["lv3"]
+        if (
+            kind not in LIBRARY_KIND_LABELS
+            or lv1 not in lv1_labels
+            or lv2 not in lv2_labels
+            or lv3 not in lv3_labels
+        ):
+            skipped.append({"href": href, "reason": "missing-target-label", "decision": decision})
+            continue
+
+        before = {
+            "kind": article.get("libraryKindKey") or "",
+            "lv1": article.get("topicLv1Key") or "",
+            "lv2": article.get("topicLv2Key") or "",
+            "lv3": article.get("topicLv3Key") or "",
+        }
+
+        article["section"] = "thu-vien"
+        article["sectionLabel"] = "Thư viện"
+        article["sectionHref"] = "thu-vien.html"
+        article["libraryKindKey"] = kind
+        article["libraryKindLabel"] = LIBRARY_KIND_LABELS[kind]
+        article["cardBadgeLabel"] = LIBRARY_KIND_LABELS[kind]
+        article["topicLv1Key"] = lv1
+        article["topicLv1Label"] = lv1_labels[lv1]
+        article["topicLv2Key"] = lv2
+        article["topicLv2Label"] = lv2_labels[lv2]
+        article["topicLv3Key"] = lv3
+        article["topicLv3Label"] = lv3_labels[lv3]
+        article["cardTopicLabel"] = article["topicLv2Label"]
+        if isinstance(article.get("classificationReasons"), dict):
+            article["classificationReasons"]["phase16Batch50"] = decision["reason"]
+
+        ok, reason = update_meta(ROOT / href, article)
+        if not ok:
+            skipped.append({"href": href, "reason": reason})
+            continue
+
+        applied.append(
+            {
+                "href": href,
+                "title": article.get("title") or "",
+                "reason": decision["reason"],

+                "after": {

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Phase 17: batch 50 - gom các biểu mẫu thuế đang lạc ngoài nhánh Thuế."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import importlib.util
+import json
+import re
+from datetime import datetime
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Dict, List, Tuple
+
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
+OUT_JSON = ROOT / "docs" / "thu-vien-phase17-batch50.json"
+OUT_MD = ROOT / "docs" / "thu-vien-phase17-batch50.md"
+
+META_RE = re.compile(
+    r'(<script id="article-meta" type="application/json">)(.*?)(</script>)',
+    re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL,
+)
+
+LIBRARY_KIND_LABELS = {
+    "huong-dan": "Hướng dẫn",
+    "bieu-mau": "Biểu mẫu",
+    "cong-cu": "Công cụ",
+    "van-ban": "Văn bản",
+}
+
+
+def load_importer_module():
+    module_path = ROOT / "tools" / "import_stage1_20.py"
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("importer_phase17_batch50", module_path)
+    if spec is None or spec.loader is None:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"Không import được module: {module_path}")
+    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    spec.loader.exec_module(module)  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+    return module
+
+
+def build_label_maps(articles: List[Dict]) -> Tuple[Dict[str, str], Dict[str, str], Dict[str, str]]:
+    lv1: Dict[str, str] = {}
+    lv2: Dict[str, str] = {}
+    lv3: Dict[str, str] = {}
+    for a in articles:
+        if a.get("topicLv1Key"):
+            lv1.setdefault(a["topicLv1Key"], a.get("topicLv1Label") or a["topicLv1Key"])
+        if a.get("topicLv2Key"):
+            lv2.setdefault(a["topicLv2Key"], a.get("topicLv2Label") or a["topicLv2Key"])
+        if a.get("topicLv3Key"):
+            lv3.setdefault(a["topicLv3Key"], a.get("topicLv3Label") or a["topicLv3Key"])
+    return lv1, lv2, lv3
+
+
+def update_meta(path: Path, article: Dict) -> Tuple[bool, str]:
+    if not path.exists():
+        return False, "missing-file"
+    html = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")
+    m = META_RE.search(html)
+    if not m:
+        return False, "missing-article-meta"
+    try:
+        meta = json.loads(m.group(2))
+    except json.JSONDecodeError:
+        return False, "invalid-article-meta-json"
+
+    for key in (
+        "section",
+        "sectionLabel",
+        "sectionHref",
+        "libraryKindKey",
+        "libraryKindLabel",
+        "cardBadgeLabel",
+        "topicLv1Key",
+        "topicLv1Label",
+        "topicLv2Key",
+        "topicLv2Label",
+        "topicLv3Key",
+        "topicLv3Label",
+        "cardTopicLabel",
+    ):
+        meta[key] = article.get(key) or ""
+    meta["sectionKey"] = article.get("section") or ""
+    meta["topicLabel"] = article.get("topicLv2Label") or article.get("topicLv1Label") or ""
+
+    replaced = html[: m.start(2)] + json.dumps(meta, ensure_ascii=False) + html[m.end(2) :]
+    path.write_text(replaced, encoding="utf-8")
+    return True, "updated"
+
+
+def rebuild(importer, data_articles: List[Dict]) -> Dict[str, int]:
+    records_by_section: Dict[str, List[Dict]] = {"thu-vien": [], "ban-tin": []}
+    for idx, item in enumerate(data_articles):
+        rec = {
+            "file": Path(item["href"]).name.replace(".html", ".htm"),
+            "target_root": item["href"],
+            "section": item["section"],
+            "title": item["title"],
+            "excerpt": item.get("excerpt") or "",
+            "content_html": "",
+            "topic_lv1_key": item.get("topicLv1Key") or "",
+            "topic_lv1_label": item.get("topicLv1Label") or "",
+            "topic_lv2_key": item.get("topicLv2Key") or "",
+            "topic_lv2_label": item.get("topicLv2Label") or "",
+            "topic_lv3_key": item.get("topicLv3Key") or "",
+            "topic_lv3_label": item.get("topicLv3Label") or "",
+            "tags": item.get("tags") or [],
+            "display_badge": item.get("cardBadgeLabel") or "",
+            "display_topic": item.get("cardTopicLabel") or "",
+            "library_kind_key": item.get("libraryKindKey") or "",
+            "library_kind_label": item.get("libraryKindLabel") or "",
+            "tool_lv3_key": item.get("toolLv3Key") or "",
+            "tool_lv3_label": item.get("toolLv3Label") or "",
+            "publish_date": item.get("publishDate") or "",
+            "modified_date": item.get("modifiedDate"),
+            "author_name": item.get("authorName") or "Kế Toán Diệu Tâm",
+            "author_type": item.get("authorType") or "Organization",
+            "hub_image": item.get("image") or importer.FEATURE_IMAGE_PATH,
+            "catalog_index": idx,
+        }
+        records_by_section[item["section"]].append(rec)
+
+    for sec in ("thu-vien", "ban-tin"):
+        records_by_section[sec].sort(key=lambda r: importer.fold(r["title"]))
+        for i, r in enumerate(records_by_section[sec]):
+            r["catalog_index"] = i
+
+    page_maps = {}
+    for sec in ("thu-vien", "ban-tin"):
+        total_pages = max(1, (len(records_by_section[sec]) + importer.PAGE_SIZE - 1) // importer.PAGE_SIZE)
+        page_maps[sec] = importer.build_page_map(sec, total_pages)
+
+    importer.rebuild_hub_pages(records_by_section, page_maps)
+    idx_data = importer.build_content_index(records_by_section)
+    importer.write_content_index(idx_data)
+    importer.write_data_artifacts(records_by_section, idx_data, page_maps)
+    importer.write_taxonomy_data(records_by_section)
+    importer.write_sitemap(idx_data, page_maps)
+    return {
+        "thu_vien_count": len(records_by_section["thu-vien"]),
+        "ban_tin_count": len(records_by_section["ban-tin"]),
+        "thu_vien_pages": len(page_maps["thu-vien"]),
+        "ban_tin_pages": len(page_maps["ban-tin"]),
+    }
+
+
+def map_tax_form_lv3(title: str) -> str:
+    t = title.lower()
+    if "nhà thầu" in t or "nha thau" in t:
+        return "mau-thue-nha-thau"
+    if "tncn" in t or "thu nhập cá nhân" in t or "khấu trừ thuế" in t:
+        return "mau-thue-tncn"
+    if "tndn" in t or "thu nhập doanh nghiệp" in t:
+        return "mau-thue-tndn"
+    if any(x in t for x in ("hộ kinh doanh", "cnkd", "bđs", "môn bài", "cho thuê nhà")):
+        return "mau-thue-ho-ca-nhan-mon-bai"
+    if any(x in t for x in ("khbs", "bảng kê", "phụ lục")):
+        return "mau-bang-ke-phu-luc-ho-so"
+    return "mau-thue-gtgt-hoa-don"
+
+
+def build_decisions(data_articles: List[Dict]) -> Dict[str, Dict[str, str]]:
+    include = re.compile(
+        r"(thuế|tờ khai|khbs|nộp tiền|nsnn|hóa đơn|hddt|mã số thuế|đăng ký thuế|quyết toán thuế|môn bài|tndn|tncn|gtgt|tài nguyên|bảo vệ môi trường|khấu trừ)",
+        re.IGNORECASE,
+    )
+    exclude = re.compile(
+        r"(phần mềm|htkk|hỗ trợ kê khai|dùng thử|excel|word|download|báo cáo thực tập|bhxh|bảo hiểm|lao động|giải thể dntn|thực tập)",
+        re.IGNORECASE,
+    )
+    exclude2 = re.compile(
+        r"(hợp đồng|khuyến mại|hội chợ|bệnh án|ra viện|chứng chỉ hành nghề|bất động sản theo nghị định 96)",
+        re.IGNORECASE,
+    )
+
+    candidates = []
+    for a in data_articles:
+        if a.get("section") != "thu-vien":
+            continue
+        if a.get("libraryKindKey") != "bieu-mau":
+            continue
+        if a.get("topicLv1Key") == "thue":
+            continue
+        title = a.get("title") or ""
+        if not include.search(title):
+            continue
+        if exclude.search(title) or exclude2.search(title):
+            continue
+        candidates.append(a)
+
+    decisions: Dict[str, Dict[str, str]] = {}
+    for a in sorted(candidates, key=lambda x: x["href"])[:50]:
+        href = a["href"]
+        decisions[href] = {
+            "kind": "bieu-mau",
+            "lv1": "thue",
+            "lv2": "mau-bieu-thue",
+            "lv3": map_tax_form_lv3(a["title"]),
+            "reason": "phase17-bieumau-tax-rebalance",
+        }
+
+    if len(decisions) != 50:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"Phase17 cần đúng 50 bài, hiện chỉ chọn được {len(decisions)}")
+    return decisions
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    importer = load_importer_module()
+    data_articles_path = importer.DATA_DIR / "articles.json"
+    data_articles: List[Dict] = importer.read_json(data_articles_path)
+    article_map = {a["href"]: a for a in data_articles}
+    lv1_labels, lv2_labels, lv3_labels = build_label_maps(data_articles)
+    decisions = build_decisions(data_articles)
+
+    applied = []
+    skipped = []
+    for href, decision in decisions.items():
+        article = article_map.get(href)
+        if not article:
+            skipped.append({"href": href, "reason": "missing-article"})
+            continue
+
+        kind = decision["kind"]
+        lv1 = decision["lv1"]
+        lv2 = decision["lv2"]
+        lv3 = decision["lv3"]
+        if (
+            kind not in LIBRARY_KIND_LABELS
+            or lv1 not in lv1_labels
+            or lv2 not in lv2_labels
+            or lv3 not in lv3_labels
+        ):
+            skipped.append({"href": href, "reason": "missing-target-label", "decision": decision})
+            continue
+
+        before = {
+            "kind": article.get("libraryKindKey") or "",
+            "lv1": article.get("topicLv1Key") or "",
+            "lv2": article.get("topicLv2Key") or "",
+            "lv3": article.get("topicLv3Key") or "",
+        }
+
+        article["section"] = "thu-vien"
+        article["sectionLabel"] = "Thư viện"
+        article["sectionHref"] = "thu-vien.html"
+        article["libraryKindKey"] = kind
+        article["libraryKindLabel"] = LIBRARY_KIND_LABELS[kind]
+        article["cardBadgeLabel"] = LIBRARY_KIND_LABELS[kind]
+        article["topicLv1Key"] = lv1
+        article["topicLv1Label"] = lv1_labels[lv1]
+        article["topicLv2Key"] = lv2
+        article["topicLv2Label"] = lv2_labels[lv2]
+        article["topicLv3Key"] = lv3
+        article["topicLv3Label"] = lv3_labels[lv3]
+        article["cardTopicLabel"] = article["topicLv2Label"]
+        if isinstance(article.get("classificationReasons"), dict):
+            article["classificationReasons"]["phase17Batch50"] = decision["reason"]
+
+        ok, reason = update_meta(ROOT / href, article)
+        if not ok:
+            skipped.append({"href": href, "reason": reason})
+            continue
+
+        applied.append(
+            {
+                "href": href,
+                "title": article.get("title") or "",
+                "reason": decision["reason"],
+                "before": before,
+                "after": {
+                    "kind": article.get("libraryKindKey") or "",
+                    "lv1": article.get("topicLv1Key") or "",
+                    "lv2": article.get("topicLv2Key") or "",
+                    "lv3": article.get("topicLv3Key") or "",
+                },
+            }
+        )
+
+    importer.write_json(data_articles_path, data_articles)
+    counts = rebuild(importer, data_articles)
+
+    payload = {
+        "generatedAt": datetime.now().isoformat(),
+        "phase": "phase17-batch50",
+        "plannedCount": len(decisions),
+        "appliedCount": len(applied),
+        "skippedCount": len(skipped),
+        "applied": applied,
+        "skipped": skipped,
+        "after": {"countsAfterRebuild": counts},
+    }
+    OUT_JSON.write_text(json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+
+    lines = [
+        "# Phase 17 - Batch 50",
+        "",
+        f"- Thời gian chạy: `{datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')}`",
+        f"- Planned: **{len(decisions)}**",
+        f"- Applied: **{len(applied)}**",
+        f"- Skipped: **{len(skipped)}**",
+        f"- Rebuild: Thư viện {counts['thu_vien_count']} bài / {counts['thu_vien_pages']} trang; Bản tin {counts['ban_tin_count']} bài / {counts['ban_tin_pages']} trang",
+        "",
+        "## Các bài đã chỉnh",
+        "",
+        "| # | href | before | after | reason |",
+        "|---:|---|---|---|---|",
+    ]
+    for i, row in enumerate(applied, 1):
+        b = row["before"]
+        a = row["after"]
+        lines.append(
+            f"| {i} | `{row['href']}` | `{b['kind']} / {b['lv1']} / {b['lv2']} / {b['lv3']}` | `{a['kind']} / {a['lv1']} / {a['lv2']} / {a['lv3']}` | `{row['reason']}` |"
+        )
+    if skipped:
+        lines += ["", "## Skipped", ""]
+        for row in skipped:
+            lines.append(f"- `{row['href']}`: {row['reason']}")
+    OUT_MD.write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+
+    print(
+        json.dumps(
+            {
+                "planned": len(decisions),
+                "applied": len(applied),
+                "skipped": len(skipped),
+                "report": str(OUT_MD.relative_to(ROOT)),
+            },
+            ensure_ascii=False,
+            indent=2,
+        )
+    )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Phase 18: batch 50 - chuyển nhóm release HTKK từ Biểu mẫu sang Công cụ."""
+

+
+import importlib.util

+
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent

+    r'(<script id="article-meta" type="application/json">)(.*?)(</script>)',

+)
+
+LIBRARY_KIND_LABELS = {
+    "huong-dan": "Hướng dẫn",
+    "bieu-mau": "Biểu mẫu",
+    "cong-cu": "Công cụ",

+}

+    module_path = ROOT / "tools" / "import_stage1_20.py"
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("importer_phase18_batch50", module_path)
+    if spec is None or spec.loader is None:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"Không import được module: {module_path}")
+    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    spec.loader.exec_module(module)  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+    return module
+
+
+def build_label_maps(articles: List[Dict]) -> Tuple[Dict[str, str], Dict[str, str], Dict[str, str]]:
+    lv1: Dict[str, str] = {}
+    lv2: Dict[str, str] = {}
+    lv3: Dict[str, str] = {}
